subject.title: fix(feishu): route SDK HTTP through ambient proxy

question: Should Feishu SDK REST/token and WebSocket-bootstrap HTTP follow OpenClaw’s ambient proxy agent, with managed proxy mode overriding caller-supplied agents?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but this choice changes credentialed network egress and precedence for existing Feishu deployments; code inspection cannot determine the intended operator security and compatibility policy.

options.title: Approve The Proxy Contract
options.body: Accept ambient proxy routing and managed-mode agent override, then rebase and merge after exact-head checks.

options.title: Limit To Managed Proxy
options.body: Apply forced routing only while OpenClaw managed proxy mode is active and leave ordinary ambient-proxy inheritance unchanged.

options.title: Wait For Channel Policy
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define an explicit Feishu direct, ambient, or bypass policy for mixed-network deployments.

recommendation.title: Approve The Proxy Contract
recommendation.body: Accept ambient proxy routing and managed-mode agent override, then rebase and merge after exact-head checks.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across the Feishu client, WebSocket recovery, heartbeat, timeout, and dependency-boundary surfaces affected by this choice.
